issue.title: waveform: option to invert zoom direction for mousewheel scroll?

llm_context.input_title: waveform: option to invert zoom direction for mousewheel scroll?
llm_context.input_body: No body provided in issue description.

generated_output.summary: The user is requesting a feature in the waveform preferences to add a radio-box or setting option to invert the zoom direction when scrolling with the mousewheel over the waveform.
generated_output.root_cause_analysis: The preference option for inverting mousewheel zoom direction on waveforms is currently unimplemented or was previously dropped during earlier merges (#9952, #4195), meaning the zoom delta calculation does not check any user configuration flag for inversion.

step_by_step_plan.title: Inspect waveform preference settings and zoom handling
step_by_step_plan.description: Examine src/mixxxmainwindow.cpp and related waveform preference configuration files to locate mousewheel zoom delta computation and existing preference connections.

step_by_step_plan.title: Add preference option for inverting waveform mousewheel zoom
step_by_step_plan.description: Introduce a configuration setting and corresponding radio-box or checkbox option in the waveform preferences dialog UI/backend logic to allow users to toggle zoom inversion.

step_by_step_plan.title: Apply zoom inversion logic based on preference flag
step_by_step_plan.description: Update the mousewheel scroll event handler for the waveform display to check the new preference flag and invert the zoom delta calculation accordingly.

step_by_step_plan.title: Add regression tests and execute test suite
step_by_step_plan.description: Add unit tests verifying that toggling the invert mousewheel zoom preference correctly alters the sign or direction of the resulting zoom delta, then run the test suite to confirm.

structured_concepts.short_explanation: Storing and retrieving user-configurable settings through Mixxx's settings management system.
structured_concepts.why_it_matters: Allows user interface components and event handlers to adapt their runtime behavior based on individual user workflow preferences.
structured_concepts.connection_to_issue: An invert zoom preference needs to be stored in the settings backend and read when handling mousewheel scroll events on the waveform.

structured_concepts.short_explanation: Intercepting and responding to QWheelEvent objects in Qt widgets to control scaling or scrolling.
structured_concepts.why_it_matters: Enables interactive visual feedback like zooming in and out when users scroll their mouse over graphical widgets.
structured_concepts.connection_to_issue: The mousewheel event handler for the waveform widget must multiply the scroll delta by -1 when the invert zoom preference is enabled.

common_pitfalls: Forgetting to wire the preference change signal to update the waveform widget state dynamically.
Hardcoding the inversion flag instead of persisting it in the configuration store.
